target_lang_definitions.en: To attract someone's attention and arouse their curiosity.

target_lang_definitions.tr: Birinin dikkatini çekmek ve merakını uyandırmak.
target_lang_definitions.es: Despertar la atención y la curiosidad de alguien.
target_lang_definitions.zh: 吸引某人的注意力，激起其好奇心。

target_lang_definitions.en: To be financially or materially attractive to someone, offering an advantage.
